description: A path-following measurement set with five designed branches and five questions at every hop count from 1 through 10. Evaluation truth is entirely contained in trusted_context.
trusted_context: Apollo 11 was crewed by Neil Armstrong. Neil Armstrong was born in Wapakoneta. Wapakoneta is located in Ohio. Ohio is part of the United States. The United States has its capital in Washington, D.C. Washington, D.C. is located on the Potomac River. The Potomac River flows to Chesapeake Bay. Chesapeake Bay opens into the Atlantic Ocean. The Atlantic Ocean is part of the Global Ocean. The Global Ocean is studied by Oceanography. Apollo 11 was launched by Saturn V. Saturn V had the S-IC as its first stage. The S-IC was built by Boeing. Boeing assembled the S-IC at Michoud Assembly Facility. Michoud Assembly Facility is located in New Orleans. New Orleans is located in the state of Louisiana. Louisiana belongs to the Gulf Coast region. The Gulf Coast borders the Gulf of Mexico. The Gulf of Mexico is connected to the Atlantic Ocean. The Atlantic Ocean is studied by Oceanography. Apollo 11 used Columbia as its command module. Columbia is preserved at the National Air and Space Museum. The National Air and Space Museum is located in Washington, D.C. For this designed graph, Washington, D.C. hosts the Smithsonian Institution. The Smithsonian Institution was founded by the United States Congress. The United States Congress convenes at the United States Capitol. The United States Capitol is located on Capitol Hill. Capitol Hill overlooks the National Mall. The National Mall contains the Smithsonian Castle. The Smithsonian Castle is administered by the Smithsonian Institution. Apollo 11 used Eagle as its lunar module. Eagle's descent stage is located on the Moon. The Moon has the Sea of Tranquility as the landing region for Eagle. The Sea of Tranquility is part of the Lunar Near Side. The Lunar Near Side is visible from Earth. Earth is studied by Lunar Geology for comparative purposes in this test graph. Lunar Geology uses samples from Apollo Missions. Apollo Missions includes Apollo 11. Apollo 11 was launched by Saturn V. Saturn V had the S-IC as its first stage. Apollo 11 was part of the Apollo Program. The Apollo Program was preceded by the Gemini Program. The Gemini Program included Gemini 8. Gemini 8 was commanded by Neil Armstrong. Neil Armstrong experienced the Stuck Thruster event during Gemini 8. The Stuck Thruster event was resolved by Mission Abort. Mission Abort is classified as an Emergency Procedure. The Emergency Procedure is documented in the Gemini 8 Mission Report. The Gemini 8 Mission Report is archived by NASA. NASA is headquartered in Washington, D.C.
